name: Pre-Raphaelite

influenced_by: a reaction against the Royal Academy's teaching

garments: unbound red hair as a recurring motif

media.title: Dante Gabriel Rossetti's portraits of Jane Morris and Elizabeth Siddal

reacts_against: the Royal Academy's idealized, Raphael-descended teaching style, choosing jewel-bright color and literal detail from nature instead.
revivals: a visible influence on gothic-lolita and princesscore's romantic silhouettes

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Medievalism, Arthurian legend, religious and mythological subjects, literary themes, detailed natural landscapes, idealized female figures
wiki_facts.key_colours: Vivid jewel tones (cobalt, ruby, emerald), luminous whites
wiki_facts.key_values: Sincere representation, truth to nature, moral seriousness, opposition to academic conventions

findings: dark — about 54% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 46% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
